title: Terms and Conditions
intro: These terms cover the use of this website and the travel arrangements we sell. Please read them before you send an enquiry or confirm a booking.

sections.heading: About these terms
paragraphs: This website is operated by RITA Tours N Travels, Keizersgracht 100, Amsterdam, the Netherlands. By browsing the site, sending an enquiry or confirming a booking, you agree to these terms.

Where you book on behalf of other travellers, you confirm you are authorised to share their details and to accept these terms for them. Our contact address for anything in these terms is hello@ritatoursandtravels.eu.

sections.heading: Enquiries and proposals
paragraphs: Prices and itineraries shown on this site are indicative. They are not an offer and may change with availability, season and supplier rates.

An enquiry does not create a booking. After you send one, we prepare a proposal that states the price, what is included and how long the offer stands — normally seven days. A contract exists only once you accept that proposal in writing and pay the required deposit.

sections.heading: Bookings and payment
paragraphs: Unless your proposal says otherwise, a deposit of 25% of the journey price is due on confirmation, with the balance due 60 days before departure. Bookings made inside 60 days are payable in full on confirmation.
Journey prices are per person based on two people sharing a room. Single occupancy, private transfers, upgrades and optional experiences are priced separately.
All prices are quoted and invoiced in euros. Currency conversions shown on the site are indicative and are not used for billing.
If a payment is not received by its due date we may treat the booking as cancelled by you and apply the cancellation scale below.

sections.heading: Changes you ask for
paragraphs: Please send any change request in writing as early as you can. We will do our best to accommodate it, subject to availability.

A change may carry supplier fees, a difference in price and, for changes made within 30 days of departure, an administration charge. Where a change is not possible, your original booking stays in place.
You may transfer a booking to another traveller who meets the conditions of the journey, if you tell us in writing at least seven days before departure and cover any costs charged by suppliers.

sections.heading: Changes and cancellations by us
paragraphs: We may make minor changes to your itinerary — a hotel of equivalent standard, a different but comparable transport time, a guide substitution — when circumstances require it. We will tell you as soon as we can.

If we must make a significant change before departure, such as a different destination or a change of more than 12 hours to your departure, you may accept the change, take a comparable alternative, or cancel and receive a refund of payments made.

We cancel a journey only when forced to by circumstances outside our control — for example a safety warning, a supplier failure, or too few travellers for a departure we agreed to run. In that case you receive a full refund of payments made, and we help you rearrange your travel where possible.

sections.heading: Cancellations and refunds
paragraphs: Unless your proposal states otherwise, if you cancel before departure the following charges apply:
More than 60 days before departure: the deposit is retained. 59 to 30 days: 50% of the journey price. 29 to 15 days: 75% of the journey price. 14 days or fewer, or no-show: 100% of the journey price.

Some arrangements — scheduled flights, special-event hotels, private guides — are non-refundable once confirmed. Where that applies, it is written in your proposal and those amounts are not refunded on cancellation.
Approved refunds are paid to the original payment method within 14 days of the date we confirm the cancellation.

sections.heading: Travel insurance
paragraphs: You must hold travel insurance for the whole trip that covers medical treatment and repatriation, cancellation and curtailment, baggage and personal liability. Please send us the policy number before departure. We can suggest a policy, but arranging cover and checking that it fits your needs remains your responsibility.

sections.heading: Passports, visas and health
paragraphs: You are responsible for holding a valid passport, for any visa or entry permit required, and for meeting vaccination and health requirements for every country on your itinerary. We share general guidance and official links, but requirements can change and are yours to verify with the relevant embassy or health authority before you travel.

Please tell us about any medical condition, allergy, mobility need or dietary requirement when you book so the journey can be planned safely. We treat this information confidentially and share only what a supplier needs to know.

sections.heading: Your responsibilities
paragraphs: Arrive at meeting points and departure times as confirmed; we cannot hold a group or refund services missed because of a late arrival. Behave considerately towards other travellers, guides and local communities, and respect local laws and customs. You are responsible for damage you cause to hotels, transport or other property.

sections.heading: Our responsibilities
paragraphs: We plan and deliver your journey with reasonable skill and care and select our local partners carefully. If a service is not performed as agreed, we will put it right where we reasonably can, or offer an appropriate price reduction or compensation in line with EU package travel rules.

We are not responsible for services you book independently, nor for events outside our control such as extreme weather, natural disasters, strikes, civil unrest, epidemics or government action. Where such an event affects your trip, we will help you adjust your plans and pass on any refunds we recover from suppliers.

sections.heading: Third-party suppliers
paragraphs: Flights, rail journeys, hotels and some activities are provided by third parties and are also subject to their own terms and conditions — for example airline baggage rules or hotel cancellation policies. Where those terms conflict with these terms on a matter only they can govern, their terms apply to that service.

sections.heading: If something goes wrong
paragraphs: Tell your guide or our local partner immediately so the issue can be fixed during the trip. If it cannot be resolved there, contact us at hello@ritatoursandtravels.eu or +31 20 000 0000.
You can also raise a complaint in writing within 28 days of returning home. We acknowledge complaints within five business days and aim to give a full answer within 14 days.

sections.heading: Limits of liability
paragraphs: Except where the law provides otherwise, our liability for any claim relating to a journey is limited to the total price paid for that journey. We are not liable for indirect losses such as lost profit or missed connections you arranged separately.
Nothing in these terms limits our liability for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, for fraud, or for any right you have as a consumer under Dutch or EU law.

sections.heading: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Netherlands, and the courts of Amsterdam have jurisdiction. If you live elsewhere in the EU, this does not remove the protection of the mandatory consumer rules of your country of residence.

sections.heading: Contact us
paragraphs: RITA Tours N Travels, Keizersgracht 100, Amsterdam, Netherlands. Email hello@ritatoursandtravels.eu, phone +31 20 000 0000. We reply within one business day.
